patch.value: GH-1624: define typed Unicode handling for extension output across JSON and TOON

GitHub report https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1624 describes an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate from extension output causing an untyped TOON TypeError while JSON succeeds. Reproduce through the public host command boundary, then define consistent field-aware refusal or explicitly documented normalization and a reusable SDK primitive. This concerns already-malformed external output, distinct from completed persisted-input validation and valid-pair compaction fixes.

Reproduce nested values and object keys through the actual extension host on Node and Bun; Preserve valid astral pairs and input immutability; Publish the SDK contract and JSON/TOON parity with pre-fix negative controls
Extension output has a documented consistent Unicode policy and actionable typed diagnostics across formats, while valid sibling data and valid surrogate pairs are preserved according to that policy.
